fields.acceptance: internal/daemon lock tests: a second lock on the same root fails, from a project dir and from the root alike; a testscript gets exit 2 with the next from rhiza daemon outside any root.
fields.statement: rhiza daemon runs on the root, never on a single repo: run anywhere under the root it resolves the root and holds one lock in the root's state folder (<root>/.rhiza-root/), so a second daemon on the same root refuses to start, and outside a root it exits 2 with next rhiza root init.

fields.acceptance: Daemon tests with a root of two initialised projects and one bare checkout start a ready change set in each initialised project and record the bare one as skipped, not initialised.
fields.statement: Each poll of the root daemon reads every registered, initialised project and starts its ship-change runs, plan requests and resumes as the per-repo daemon did, in that project's own checkout and journal; a project that is not initialised is skipped and daemon status says so.

fields.acceptance: internal/daemon pick tests: with maxRuns 3 and projects A (3 ready), B (2 ready) and C (1 ready), the picks are A1, B1, C1; with A's per-project max 1 and maxRuns 4, A gets one slot and the rest go to B and C.
fields.statement: The root daemon fills the machine-wide maxRuns round-robin across projects, each turn taking that project's next ready change set in its own roadmap order, and never runs more of a project's change sets at once than its optional per-project max.

fields.acceptance: A testscript sets a machine key and a project key, finds the first in rhiza.toml and the second in that repo's git config, sees both in daemon settings --json with their scope and source, and gets exit 2 for a project key set at the root with no --project.
fields.statement: rhiza daemon settings lists every setting with its scope, machine (from rhiza.toml: maxRuns, usage budget and reserve, minFree, web host and port, selfUpdate, permissionMode, paused) or project (from that repo's git config: autonomy per stage, project paused, per-project maxRuns, deploy check), and rhiza daemon set writes each key to its scope, taking --project or the current project for project keys.

fields.acceptance: internal/daemon usage tests: a limit hit recorded by one project's driver holds starts in a second project, and the hold lifts for both at the reset time.
fields.statement: The root daemon keeps one usage governor for the machine: run drivers of every project record usage-limit hits in the root's state folder, and the governor's hold stops new runs in all projects at once.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake systemctl on PATH runs daemon install from inside a project and finds one unit whose WorkingDirectory is the root, then start, stop and uninstall call systemctl on that unit.
fields.statement: rhiza daemon install writes and enables one systemd user unit for the root (rhiza-root.service, working directory the root), and rhiza daemon start, stop, status and uninstall act on the root's daemon from anywhere under the root.

fields.acceptance: internal/daemon selfupdate tests: with self_update_project set, the fake git and make run in that project's checkout; unset, neither runs.
fields.statement: With selfUpdate on, the root daemon keeps itself current from the project rhiza.toml names as self_update_project: it fast-forwards that project's main checkout and runs make update there when origin/main moves, as today's self-update does; with none named it never self-updates.

fields.acceptance: A daemon or run test with two projects and a fake rex records window new calls with -s rhiza-<project> for each project's run.
fields.statement: Every Rex tab the root daemon's runs open opens in its project's fixed session, rhiza-<project>, so each project's agent panes stay together and rhiza inbox open and run open keep finding them.
